name: Warsaw Pact: raid from N2 at dusk, 21 aircraft (enemy air command)
description: Generated by the enemy air command, campaign day 3, dusk, weather cloudy. The warning net reports a raid coming in from N2. The battery is deployed in its prepared position; the NPC commanders run the crew and the battery. Take a seat, or command the vehicle.
notes: Generated by simcore/air_war/raid_scenario.hpp from campaign day 3. Fictional; every aircraft number is a PLACEHOLDER (data/air_war/). The NPC commanders run the crew and the battery. A sample kept in data/scenarios for the missions menu, regenerated (roadmap S8, 19 November 2026) from the tuned theatre, dated 15 October 1985: `air_war_demo --build-only warsaw_pact 8 data out 10` writes it as air_war_warsaw_pact_52. Its clock_start and date are its planner's, by the sun (docs/LIGHT.md section 5), and its aircraft carry their types' flight limits (roadmap R3, aircraft.hpp).
